entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Maj. Brian Sutherland

entries.author: SPC Jensen Guillory
entries.note: US Army soldier walking, near front-on, full body: OCP uniform, plate carrier, helmet with NVG mount, M4A1 slung forward, face mask.

entries.note: Two US Army soldiers standing, front, full body: OCP uniform, plate carriers, helmets, M4A1 carbines held low; dry light shows carrier shape clearly.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Collin Mackall
entries.note: Rifleman aiming, from behind and left: back panel of the plate carrier with name tape, side pouches, helmet rear with counterweight, M4A1.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Collin Mackall
entries.note: Over-the-shoulder close-up: helmet cover, rear of the helmet and NVG mount, collar of the carrier, M4A1 with optic.

entries.author: US Army
entries.note: IHPS helmet (coyote, no cover) with NVG shroud and rails, side view on a stand; small image.

entries.author: Lawrence1215
entries.note: Modular Scalable Vest in OCP with pouches, front three-quarter on a table: carrier shape, cummerbund, pouch layout.

entries.author: Photo Courtesy of PEO Soldier, modified by User:MathKnight-at-TAU
entries.note: M4A1 carbine, right side profile on white: rail handguard, collapsible stock, M68 CCO optic (PEO Soldier photo, edited).

entries.author: Артём Финн (Artyom Finn)
entries.note: Group of Russian soldiers standing, front, full body: EMR (Digital Flora) uniforms, Ratnik 6B47 helmets and 6B45 vests, AK-74M rifles.

entries.author: Igor Rudenko (Игорь Руденко).
entries.note: Two Russian soldiers advancing up a slope, front quarter: EMR uniform, 6B47 helmet, 6B45 vest, AK-74M; boots and kneepads.

entries.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
entries.note: Infantry standing at a parade rehearsal (2014), several from the side and behind: EMR uniform, vest back, helmets, AKs carried. Older pre-Ratnik helmets and vests on some; parade dress, not field kit.

entries.author: User:VitalyKuzmin
entries.note: 6B45 Ratnik body armour in EMR on a display mannequin, front: collar, groin protector, MOLLE pouches.

entries.author: Chris P. - bevarnow
entries.note: 6B47 helmet with EMR cover on a display head, front-left: shell shape, cover, chinstrap. Display piece carries a St George ribbon band, not field issue.

entries.author: Chris P. - bevarnow
entries.note: 6B47 helmet with EMR cover, rear: cover drawstring and shell profile.

entries.author: Pkm-betta
entries.note: AK-74M, right side, with a side-rail collimator sight, on a plain wall.

entries.author: US Army Photo by Sgt. Matthew Hulet, Viper Combat Camera USAREUR
entries.note: German paratrooper standing in a field, front-left quarter, full body: Flecktarn uniform, olive plate carrier with pouches, covered helmet with NVG mount, G36 held low, face paint.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Three Bundeswehr soldiers walking, front quarter, full body: Flecktarn uniforms, Flecktarn plate carriers with pouches, covered helmets, gloves, G36 rifles at the ready, dark boots.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Bundeswehr soldier aiming round a wall, near side profile, full body: Flecktarn trousers and sleeves, coyote plate carrier, helmet with cover and NVG mount, knee pads, rifle shouldered.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Two Bundeswehr soldiers running, front quarter, full body: Flecktarn uniforms and carriers, helmets with headsets, glasses, rifles at the ready.

entries.author: Tim Rademacher
entries.note: Bundeswehr soldiers clearing a house, several seen from behind: Flecktarn uniforms, carrier backs, helmet rears; small figures.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Staff Sgt. Thomas Duval, Multinational Battle Group-East Public Affairs
entries.note: Bundeswehr soldier aiming a G36, close-up: Flecktarn helmet cover with NVG mount, face cover, carrier straps, the G36's carry-handle optic and slab sides.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Spc. Lloyd Villanueva
entries.note: German soldier aiming a G36 round a wall, close: the G36's side profile (carry-handle optic, skeleton folding stock, slim handguard, curved translucent magazine), Flecktarn jacket, helmet.

entries.author: Boevaya mashina
entries.note: G36A3 on a table, side: rail handguard, folding stock, optic rail, drum and box magazines; the current Bundeswehr rifle.

entries.author: Nickel nitride
entries.note: AK-12 (2023) on a display wall, side: black, skeleton folding and telescoping stock, ribbed dust cover with a rail, ribbed polymer magazine, rail-topped handguard over the gas tube, front sight and brake.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: AK-12 6P70 (2016) in a digital camouflage finish, three-quarter: adjustable stock, collimator on the dust-cover rail, slotted handguard, muzzle device.

gaps: us_army_ocp: no side profile or straight rear of a standing soldier found; the three-quarter rear and the details cover the carrier back and helmet.
us_army_ocp: no top view (none expected for infantry).
eastern_emr: no side profile or field photo from behind in Ratnik kit; the three-quarter rear is a 2014 parade rehearsal with older helmets and vests on some soldiers.
both: team weapons (machine gun, AT launcher) deployed and carried are not covered in this pass.

german_flecktarn: shared with europe_recon_patrol_light_patrol; no straight rear of a standing soldier; the side view is a 2026 open day, whose coyote carrier differs from the Flecktarn carriers of the other photos (the look takes Flecktarn).
